text:
I would like to know if there were 450 citizens killed. I never found out anything. I did find that they had buried 450 civilians at the base of the mountain that they found a mass grave later on after the war was over. The mountain name is Nui Ba Din. This was at the end of my service. I was medivac out a couple days later. 

When I got back to duty at Ton Son Nuht and I went to a medic that was right to my workstation and told him I felt sick and he said no wonder, you have yellow jaundice. I was at Camp Zama in Japan in Sugami Uro.
